description.en: Tender is a landing page for B2B SaaS that serves contractors, procurement teams, and government vendors: explain the path to a ready bid, show features by sector, compare plans, answer questions, and start free trials.
description.id: Tender adalah landing page untuk SaaS B2B bagi kontraktor, tim pengadaan, dan vendor pemerintah: jelaskan alur menuju dokumen penawaran siap kirim, tampilkan fitur per sektor, bandingkan paket, jawab pertanyaan, dan mulai uji coba gratis.
